en.title: Download FishBase and SeaLifeBase Data
en.description:
This function downloads the tables of a FishBase and/or SeaLifeBase release (the static
snapshots of the database tables used by the rfishbase package, as parquet files) to
`data_dir`, so they can be used offline. By default it downloads the tables the package uses
(species, estimate, families, synonyms, stocks and faoareas: about 15 MB for each database);
a complete release takes about 140 MB for FishBase and 110 MB for SeaLifeBase.
en.details:
Downloading beforehand is optional: functions that use FishBase data, such as
`fishbase_match()`, look online for the newest release first and download the tables they
need. When the computer is offline they use the newest release downloaded here, and when
nothing has been downloaded, `fishbase_match()` uses the table built into the package. Tables
already downloaded are skipped, so an interrupted download can be resumed by running the
function again.

Reading the tables needs the nanoparquet package (`install.packages("nanoparquet")`).
FishBase and SeaLifeBase data are licensed CC BY-NC 4.0 by the FishBase team: they can be
used with attribution, but not commercially.
en.value:
Invisibly, a data frame with one row per table: server, version, table, size and
status ("downloaded", "already downloaded" or "failed").

arguments.version: The release to download, e.g. "26.06". Default is "latest".
arguments.tables:
"needed" (default) for the tables the package uses, "all" for every table, or
table names, e.g. `c("species", "estimate")`.
arguments.data_dir: The directory where the data is saved. Default is `fao_data_dir()`.
arguments.overwrite:
A logical value. If TRUE, tables already downloaded are downloaded again.
Default is FALSE.
arguments.quiet: A logical value. If TRUE, progress messages are not printed. Default is FALSE.

zh.title: 下载FishBase和SeaLifeBase数据表
zh.description: 本函数把FishBase和/或SeaLifeBase某个版本的数据表（rfishbase包使用的数据库表静态快照，parquet文件格式）下载到`data_dir`，以便离线使用。默认下载本包用到的数据表（species、estimate、families、synonyms、stocks和faoareas：每个数据库约15 MB）；一个完整的版本，FishBase约140 MB，SeaLifeBase约110 MB。
zh.details:
提前下载不是必需的：使用FishBase数据的函数（如`fishbase_match()`）会先在网上查找最新的版本，并下载所需的数据表。电脑离线时，它们使用在这里下载的最新版本；什么都没有下载时，`fishbase_match()`使用包内自带的数据表。已下载的数据表会跳过，所以下载中断后，重新运行本函数即可接着下载。

读取这些数据表需要nanoparquet包（`install.packages("nanoparquet")`）。FishBase和SeaLifeBase的数据由FishBase团队以CC BY-NC 4.0许可协议发布：注明出处即可使用，但不得用于商业用途。
zh.value: 以不可见方式返回一个数据框，每张数据表一行：数据库（server）、版本（version）、表名（table）、大小（size，字节）和状态（status）；状态为"downloaded"（已下载）、"already downloaded"（此前已下载）或"failed"（下载失败）。

arguments.version: 要下载的版本，例如"26.06"。默认为"latest"（网上最新的版本）。
arguments.tables: "needed"（默认）表示本包用到的数据表，"all"表示全部数据表，也可以给出表名，例如`c("species", "estimate")`。
arguments.data_dir: 保存数据的目录。默认为`fao_data_dir()`。
arguments.overwrite: 逻辑值。为TRUE时，已下载的数据表会重新下载。默认为FALSE。
arguments.quiet: 逻辑值。为TRUE时不显示进度信息。默认为FALSE。
